definitions.explanation: The academic discipline concerned with teeth and the treatment of oral diseases. Refers to the field of study, not the practice or clinic itself.

examples.japanese: {歯学|しがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歯学|しがく}{博士|はくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学位|がくい}→学位：10196_gakui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He holds a doctorate in dentistry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯学|しがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{審美|しんび}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Modern dentistry places emphasis on cavity prevention and cosmetic treatment.

notes:
⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (science, field of study). Like ⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ and ⟦{薬学|やくがく}→薬学：19156_yakugaku⟧, the 〜⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ suffix forms the name of an academic field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯学|しがく}{部|ぶ}: faculty of dentistry
- {歯学|しがく}{博士|はくし}: doctor of dentistry (DDS)
- {歯学|しがく}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: dental research

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧: dentistry (clinical) — refers to the dental practice/clinic or the clinical branch; ⟦{歯科|しか}{医|い}→歯科医：19394_shikai⟧ = dentist
- {歯学|しがく}: dental science — the academic discipline
- {口腔外科|こうくうげか}: oral surgery — surgical sub-specialty
